name: Nar'thalas Almanac

angles.text: As a mage, you know the scholarly value of texts on ancient arcane traditions. Adding recovered works to a library's magical collection matters deeply.

As a Night Elf, you know Nar'thalas as an ancient center of Kaldorei arcane scholarship before the Sundering shattered the old world. An almanac bearing its name links you to ancient night elven history.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can help scholars and curators in Alliance archives seek rare manuscripts and expand the realm's gathered lore.

faq.answer: The Nar'thalas Almanac is a rare ancient manuscript of magical scholarship sought by curators for their historical archives. Those who recover it place its insights in scholarly care, where they can be preserved and cataloged.
Library scholars interested in ancient magical texts and historical archives collect the almanac. Curators actively seek additions to expand their shared knowledge of the world's arcane heritage.
faq.q: Who is collecting the Nar'thalas Almanac?

faq.answer: Nar'thalas was an ancient Kaldorei center of learning and magical study before the Great Sundering. Texts bearing its name preserve fragments of pre-Sundering arcane arts and elven knowledge.
faq.q: What does the name Nar'thalas refer to?

faq.answer: Historical records and magical treatises were displaced, lost, or buried in ruins across Azeroth. Scholars study recovered writings to broaden their understanding of arcane currents and guard fragile records against being lost entirely.
faq.q: Why are magical texts being collected for the library?

faq.answer: Treatises, tomes, and forgotten manuscripts can shed light on arcane theory and ancient history. Scholars continually seek additions to enrich their shelves.
faq.q: Can other magical works be brought to the library?

faq.answer: The almanac is a compiled record of study, not a volatile forbidden artifact. Historians and practitioners can use it as a valuable reference on historical magic.
faq.q: Is the Nar'thalas Almanac dangerous to handle?

sections.body: A rare work of arcane study, the Nar'thalas Almanac comes from the ancient traditions of pre-Sundering night elven scholarship. For caretakers of great archives, securing the volume rescues centuries-old lore from obscurity and adds an important piece of history to their shelves. Those who uncover neglected works help bridge forgotten antiquity and modern scholarship.
sections.title: A Relic of Ancient Study

sections.body: Across Azeroth, archivists and researchers seek lost treatises, field notes, and chronicles. Bringing the Nar'thalas Almanac to a dedicated library lets its keepers safeguard, catalog, and study it, rather than leave it to rot in ruins or fall into careless hands. Each recovered volume offers fresh insight into the arcane arts of past eras.
sections.title: Expanding the Archives

summary: Scholars seek the Nar'thalas Almanac to preserve ancient magical study. Its recovery brings forgotten lore into a library where researchers can study it.
